item.title: Defensive Driving Services
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Award | $375K | Vendor: National Traffic Safety Institute Corporation

DCAS is requesting to extend the contract for 18 months from February 28, 2026, to August 27, 2027 to continue defensive driving services with National Traffic Safety Institute Corporation (NTSI) through the Negotiated Acquisition Extension procurement method pursuant to §3-04(b)(2)(iii) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules.

The cost of this NAE will be $375,000.00. This extension is needed while DCAS works on an RFP for a new contract. DCAS is currently in the evaluation process to award a vendor.

The term of the original contract was March 1, 2017, through February 28, 2020.

DCAS renewed the contract CT1856 20205401621 for a period of 3 years term from February 29, 2020 through February 27, 2023.

DCAS has exercised the 1-year ACCO extension, from February 28, 2023 through February 27, 2024. DCAS has exercised the first NAE(CT120248806088) from February 28, 2024 through February 27, 2025.

DCAS has exercised the second NAE (CTI 20258807034) from February 28, 2025 through February 27, 2026 and will be utilizing a third NAE.

item.title: Demo Micro-Hydro Turbines
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-07-27

Pursuant to Section 3-11 of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the New York City Department of Citywide Administrative Services ('DCAS') intends to enter into a contract with InPipe Energy Inc to utilize the Demonstration Project method for Innovative Products, Approaches or Technologies to procure testing of Micro-Hydro Turbine for energy recovery from pressurized water in a discharge line from the Department of Environmental Protections (DEP) East Branch reservoir. The term of the agreement is for two years for testing their HydroXS-M8-37kW (HydroXS) Micro-Hydro Turbine for energy recovery from pressurized water in a discharge line from the Department of Environmental Protections (DEP) East Branch reservoir in Putnam County, NY for a cost not to exceed $1,132,267.90. EPIN 85626D0002. This advertisement is for informational purposes only.

Any firm that believes it could also provide these requirements can be considered in future procurements conducted by the Agency. Any Expressions of Interest can be sent to alichen@dcas.nyc.gov.
